title: Classic Tokyo & Kyoto - 7 days
summary: The classic first trip: three days in Tokyo, three in Kyoto, with a day trip to Nara.

stays.area: Shinjuku, Shibuya, or Tokyo Station area

activities.name: Free city-view observation deck
activities.notes: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observatory is free; good jet-lag-day orientation.

activities.name: Izakaya alley dinner
activities.notes: Omoide Yokocho / Golden Gai-style yakitori and small bars.

activities.name: Harajuku & Omotesando
activities.notes: Takeshita Street street fashion, then Omotesando boulevard.

activities.name: Shibuya Crossing
activities.notes: Scramble crossing; view from above at a station-side cafe or deck.

activities.name: Sunset rooftop observation deck
activities.notes: Shibuya Sky or similar; sunset slots sell out.
activities.book: Yes - timed tickets, sunset sells out

activities.name: Fish market breakfast
activities.notes: Tsukiji Outer Market stalls: sushi, tamagoyaki, grilled seafood.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise street
activities.notes: Tokyo's oldest temple and its shopping lane.

activities.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
activities.notes: Free; closed Mondays and Fridays - swap with Ueno Park/museums those days.

activities.name: Ginza department stores & depachika
activities.notes: Basement food halls are the highlight.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari torii gate hike
activities.notes: Open 24h; walk past the crowds toward the summit. Late afternoon light or early morning.

activities.name: Gion evening walk
activities.notes: Hanamikoji and Shirakawa lanes; do not photograph or follow geiko/maiko.

activities.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.notes: Before 8:00 or it is shoulder to shoulder.

activities.name: Tenryu-ji Temple garden
activities.notes: Zen garden next to the grove.

activities.name: Nara day trip
activities.notes: Todai-ji Great Buddha, Nara Park deer, Kasuga Taisha lanterns. ~45 min by train.

activities.name: Kiyomizu-dera Temple
activities.notes: Go at opening to beat crowds.

activities.name: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka lanes to Yasaka Shrine
activities.notes: Preserved slopes, tea shops; ends near Maruyama Park.

activities.name: Nishiki Market tasting walk
activities.notes: Covered food market; graze rather than sit.

legs.carrier: Narita Express, Keikyu, or Tokyo Monorail
legs.notes: Airport limousine bus is the door-to-door alternative. Set up an IC card (Suica/PASMO; Apple Wallet works).
Shinkansen. Consider forwarding large luggage (takkyubin). Nozomi is not covered by the standard JR Pass.
Open-jaw ticket. If flying home from Tokyo instead, take the Tokaido Shinkansen back (~2h15).
